## Summary

Describe the problem and the implemented solution.

## Validation

- [ ] `cmake --build build`
- [ ] `ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure`
- [ ] Script and Python syntax checks
- [ ] GPU test or an explanation of why GPU validation was not possible

## Performance claims

If this pull request changes performance, include the GPU, driver, model,
command, warmup count, measured runs, and raw report.

## Checklist

- [ ] Source-image coordinate behavior is preserved or tested.
- [ ] No model weights, downloaded dependencies, private data, or generated
  benchmark outputs are included.
- [ ] Documentation is updated.
